messages:
tomas.k: FYI Aya (contractor, UK) asked if she can carry 16h of unused PTO into next year. Her contract is part-time 0.6 FTE and she has UK bank holidays coming up. Manager approved tentative dates but wants to confirm proration and if bank holidays reduce PTO.
hr-bot: Reminder: Contractors follow the contractor addendum. Carryover for contractors is limited and pro-rated; see: https://redwood.company/policies/contractor-pto. Annual carryover cap for contractors = 24h unless an exception is approved.
aya.contractor: Hello  I had 16h left after the shutdown week and planned remote travel in Jan. I also have the UK Boxing Day bank holiday during that trip. Do I lose PTO for the bank holiday day?
tomas.k: My assumption is bank holidays on a scheduled workday are not charged against PTO per our holiday rules, but contractor schedules can vary.
olivia-peopleops: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm Aya's scheduled workdays (she's 0.6 FTE), 2) Confirm contractor addendum terms, 3) If carryover <=24h we can approve, otherwise People Ops sign-off required.
marta.payroll: Payroll/process note: contractor accruals and carryover are calculated pro-rata based on FTE and effective date. Bank holidays that fall on a scheduled workday are applied and do not consume PTO. Need Aya's standard days to confirm. Cutoff for year-end carryover tagging is Dec 22.
aya.contractor: My typical schedule is Mon/Tue/Wed (30 hours total). Boxing Day (Dec 26) is a Tues this year and would be a bank holiday here.
olivia-peopleops: Given that, Dec 26 would be applied as a paid bank holiday and would not use Aya's PTO. So the 16h carryover request stands as long as it stays under the 24h contractor cap.
tomas.k: Great. Can you also confirm whether the carryover will be shown as hours on her Jan balance or if we have to do a manual adjustment? Aya prefers it posted to balance.
marta.payroll: We batch-post contractor carryovers on Jan 3; it will appear on Jan balances automatically if tagged by Dec 22. Manual pay-out only if employee requests encashment (not common for contractors).
olivia-peopleops: Action items: Tomas add Lattice/HRIS note: "contractor carryover request 16h; Boxing Day falls on Tue - bank holiday applies; schedule Mon/Tue/Wed". People Ops to tag PO-6001 and add to Jan 3 batch.
hr-bot: people-ops ticket created: #PO-6001  olivia-peopleops assigned. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-6001
aya.contractor: Thanks all  please let me know if you need signed agreement or anything else.
tomas.k: I'll add the note now. Closing loop once tagged.
